keySentence: The frog helped because she kept her promise.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: They became friends. She kept her promise. The frog was happy. The frog helped because she kept her promise.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The princess and the frog became true friends over time. They played together and talked every single day. The frog helped because she kept her promise to him. The princess learned that keeping promises brings real friends. She was grateful to the frog for teaching her this lesson. Something magical was about to happen because of her kindness.
